pairs.question: 2026年第一季度非取消订单销售额是多少？
pairs.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(item.quantity * item.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items AS item JOIN orders AS sales_order USING (order_id) WHERE sales_order.status != 'cancelled' AND sales_order.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND sales_order.order_date < '2026-04-01'

pairs.question: 合成订单一共有多少笔？
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders

pairs.question: 状态为已完成的订单有多少笔？
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_order_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

pairs.question: 非取消订单按销售渠道统计销售额，结果从高到低是什么？
pairs.sql: SELECT sales_order.sales_channel, ROUND(SUM(item.quantity * item.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items AS item JOIN orders AS sales_order USING (order_id) WHERE sales_order.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY sales_order.sales_channel ORDER BY revenue DESC, sales_order.sales_channel LIMIT 5

pairs.question: 按非取消订单销售额计算，销售额最高的商品是什么？
pairs.sql: SELECT product.product_name, ROUND(SUM(item.quantity * item.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items AS item JOIN orders AS sales_order USING (order_id) JOIN products AS product USING (product_id) WHERE sales_order.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY product.product_id, product.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product.product_id LIMIT 1

pairs.question: 非取消订单按客户统计销售额，排名是什么？
pairs.sql: SELECT customer.customer_name, ROUND(SUM(item.quantity * item.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items AS item JOIN orders AS sales_order USING (order_id) JOIN customers AS customer USING (customer_id) WHERE sales_order.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY customer.customer_id, customer.customer_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer.customer_id LIMIT 5

pairs.question: 订单 O1001 包含哪些商品、数量、单价和行金额？
pairs.sql: SELECT product.product_name, item.quantity, item.unit_price, ROUND(item.quantity * item.unit_price, 2) AS line_amount FROM order_items AS item JOIN products AS product USING (product_id) WHERE item.order_id = 'O1001' ORDER BY item.product_id LIMIT 5

pairs.question: 列出全部十一条订单商品明细。
pairs.sql: SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price FROM order_items ORDER BY order_id, product_id LIMIT 11

pairs.question: 2026年第一季度非取消订单按月份统计销售额，按月份升序列出。
pairs.sql: SELECT substr(sales_order.order_date, 1, 7) AS order_month, ROUND(SUM(item.quantity * item.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items AS item JOIN orders AS sales_order USING (order_id) WHERE sales_order.status != 'cancelled' AND sales_order.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND sales_order.order_date < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month LIMIT 5

pairs.question: 非取消订单中，各地区的订单数和销售额分别是多少？按销售额从高到低列出。
pairs.sql: SELECT customer.region, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_order.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(item.quantity * item.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items AS item JOIN orders AS sales_order USING (order_id) JOIN customers AS customer USING (customer_id) WHERE sales_order.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY customer.region ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer.region LIMIT 5

pairs.question: 非取消订单中，按商品类别统计售出件数和销售额，按销售额从高到低列出。
pairs.sql: SELECT product.category, SUM(item.quantity) AS units_sold, ROUND(SUM(item.quantity * item.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items AS item JOIN orders AS sales_order USING (order_id) JOIN products AS product USING (product_id) WHERE sales_order.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY product.category ORDER BY revenue DESC, product.category LIMIT 5

pairs.question: 哪些客户在2026年3月有非取消订单？列出客户、订单数和销售额，按销售额降序。
pairs.sql: SELECT customer.customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_order.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(item.quantity * item.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items AS item JOIN orders AS sales_order USING (order_id) JOIN customers AS customer USING (customer_id) WHERE sales_order.status != 'cancelled' AND sales_order.order_date >= '2026-03-01' AND sales_order.order_date < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY customer.customer_id, customer.customer_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer.customer_id LIMIT 5
